# Bartlett Labs

> Founder-led missed-call recovery, AI follow-up, scheduling, CRM, and review automation for Houston-area service businesses.

## About

Bartlett Labs is a small studio based in Crosby, Texas. The work is led directly by Kyle Bartlett and focused on practical builds for local service businesses: missed-call recovery, cleaner lead capture, quote follow-up, scheduling, CRM, and review automation.

## Founder

Kyle Bartlett is a Purdue-trained engineer with 13 years of post-college experience across Sears, Belk, Apple, and Anker. He has built 300+ automations and now applies that operations background to founder-led client work.

## Services

- Missed Call Text-Back: $500 setup + $99/mo
- Automated Follow-Ups: included in the core operating system
- Simple CRM Dashboard: included in the core operating system
- Consulting & Advisory: scoped case by case

## Work

- The public Work page currently shows demo concepts built for real local businesses.
- These examples are meant to show direction, structure, and system thinking.

## Positioning

- Founder-led, not agency-layered
- Fixed-scope projects
- Built for local business owners who need one useful system first
- Strong fit for businesses around Houston, Crosby, Baytown, Huffman, and nearby areas
